notes.title: Optimization Update v0.160
notes.content:
👋 Hello streamers,
Thank you so much for supporting us by purchasing the game during Early Access! ❤️

This update focuses on addressing several performance and optimization issues:

[list]
[*] Optimization work has been done on shadows.
[*] Additional adjustments were made to improve performance when switching quality settings.
[*] General performance optimizations have been completed.
[*] Extra optimizations were applied to player-buildable objects.
[*] Fixed a major FPS drop issue caused by having too many objects in the scene.
[*] Resolved certain freezing issues occurring on low-end systems.
[*] Improved performance related to spikes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused significant FPS drops in some save files after loading.
[/list]

notes.title: Plush Update v0.156
notes.content:
[b]Hello Streamers,[/b]

We're excited to announce that our next major update is planned as the 1.0 full release version, moving the game out of Early Access. We believe a big content update will be more impactful and give current players a fresh reason to jump back in. Because of this, the preparation time will be longer than usual.

We are continuing to develop the game. and version 1.0 will be an update that will take a long time to prepare but will change many things.
This update could take until 2026. I’m planning a massive update. 


In the meantime, we'll be sharing occasional devlogs or update notes to give small spoilers about what's coming. You can follow us on Steam for future announcements.

⚠️ Important Note: The price of Streamer Life Simulator 2 will increase before the full release update. 

This current update includes a few minor additions and bug fixes. We're saving the bigger, game-changing features for version 1.0. Thank you so much to everyone who supported us during Early Access — your feedback and enthusiasm have been our biggest motivation. ❤️

🔧 Changelog:

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/de253dca8c6b0d449dea1ede24e68ea980a090e0.jpg[/img]
[*]New mouse pad variants have been added.

[*]A green screen (greenbox) has been added, usable as decoration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/4c29bf0ec748f7ea5c8f90ecba278407b4dbc074.jpg[/img]
[*]UI issues on widescreen resolutions have been fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/c7446aaca8e9905024020b7b6ecfd556c5b5b77d.jpg[/img]
[*]A slot machine has been added to the club.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/81615785b5723adcb9d2807f92ca97eda29b09a2.jpg[/img]
[*]A lucky wheel has been added to the club.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/0ee21082dfd98fde5e89e58c4e03e24b968c69e3.jpg[/img]
[*]Plush toys have been added — they can be used as decoration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/06aead61bc7a40fadcbd902b7721298e7fc123a6.jpg[/img]
[*]A frog man character has been added (he will be active in the full release).

[*]Fixed a bug where the game UI disappeared completely when resizing the browser window.

[*]Fixed a bug that prevented building certain items due to placement errors.

[*]Corrected various translation mistakes in in-game websites.

[*]A pink neon letter “Y” has been added.

[*]Field of View (FOV) settings can now go up to 90.

notes.title: Brain Rot Update v0.15
notes.content:

[u][b]We will continue to update to create a better gaming experience.[/b][/u]

🔧Fixed an issue with vehicles interacting with some items.

🔧Fixed some items and NPCs interacting with each other.
🔧Fixed some NPCs getting stuck inside houses.

✔️New game brain rot clicker

🕹️Fixed new games getting stuck on the black screen in some cases.

✔️You can now receive sponsored job offers in the mail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/951962434218651be021fae49acb384443228573.jpg[/img]

✔️Blackjack has been added to the club.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/efb96879912ad4898848abdc2f0121a90a50b89a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/523a5380d27cae7b540cc8bc9f0c323095046312.jpg[/img]

🕹️Optimized the amount of memory the game uses.

✔️You can now change some key assignments.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/5c90f48855cd4d5ac8b84a6a7ebe4badf9c2bb79.jpg[/img]

If you have any problems with the update, I'm here to solve them quickly. You can post any problems or ideas you have in the [b]Steam forum[/b] or on our [b]Discord channel[/b]. I try to read and evaluate every topic. [b]See you in the next update.[/b]

notes.title: Scratch Card Update v0.145
notes.content:
Hello streamers,
It's been exactly 1 week since our game was released and we're very happy with how it's going. Thank you so much for supporting us by buying the game during early access. Today we're back with a new small update. We've added some balancing and new content, hope you enjoy it. And we also did a little optimization work.

*some adjustments  were made on subscriber gains (experimental)
*Some adjustments were made on follower gains (experimental)
*Stabilized some gains at high follower levels.
*Automatic mod bans no longer have a sound effect.
*Some memory optimization work has been done (biggest impact on low settings)
*Pawn shop now sells scratch cards.
*The player can control their weapon more easily in camper strike if they have a quality mouse.
*Fixed a bug that prevented starting a new game in some corrapted save files.
*Some in-game UIs have been changed.
*Made some changes to the medicine system, you can now stock up on medicine.
*Donate lab added a new section. You will now be able to change your donate sound. You can choose from new donate sounds.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890830/Streamer_Life_Simulator_2

See you in the next update, have fun.
If you have any problems or want to give advice. You can use the Steam forum or our discord channel. <3

notes.title: Pawn Shop Update v0.142
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937624/19eb86ab35e49b5d40948d053bc5eb56c2a6038a.jpg[/img]
Hello streamers,
First of all, a big thank you to everyone who bought and supported the game during early access.
It's a highly requested feature, so I wanted to quickly add it to the game. It will be a bit more detailed in the future, but for now it will allow players to monetize their unused items.
And I made a few bug fixes along the way.
*Fixed a visual bug after moving to a new house and after buying a boost internet pack.
*Fixed some models causing excessive fps drops.
*Fixed the issue where the character's hair would appear white in the camera on the ops screen.
*Fixed a bug that caused a fps drop when opening the ops camera.
*Fixed an issue where the discat tutorial message would not appear in some cases.
*You can leave unused items to the pawn shop to be sold.
*You can see the location of the pawn shop on the map.
*You can buy starting computer equipment from the pawn shop for 20% more. If something happens to your starting equipment, you can get new ones here.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890830/Streamer_Life_Simulator_2
See you in future updates. Have a good time everyone. If you have any problems or want to give advice. You can use the Steam forum or our discord channel. <3

notes.title: Optimization Update v0.14
notes.content:
Hello streamers,
First of all, a big thank you to everyone who bought and supported the game during early access.
You can write your feedback about the game at any time on our discord channel and steam forum.
I've been working on an update that could significantly improve the game and I've partially completed it.
It will increase your FPS and improve your gameplay experience.
I've identified a few pain points that I'll work on and I'll do better in terms of optimization in future updates.
For now, I'm focused on making the gameplay more stable and after some tweaks I'll move on to new content.

*Optimization work has been done about the environment while the player is inside the house.
*Multiple monitors work in a more optimized way and no longer cause fps drops.
*Fixed the issue of pets consuming excessive cpu in some situations.
*Optimization work has been done on NPCs and the resource used on the cpu has been limited.
*Optimization work has been done on ai vehicles in the environment.
*Optimization work has been done on mining devices and rig case.
*Some optimization work has been done to get higher fps when the player is using the computer.
*Fps stabilization now works properly, you can enable it to lower your gpu usage.
*Some critically important models have been optimized.
*Some models that were causing excessive fps drops have been refactored.
*Fixed sometimes incorrect naming when sharing on Fakegram.
*Fixed the problem of not getting turbo internet when moving to a new home.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890830/Streamer_Life_Simulator_2/

notes.title: Hotfix v0.13
notes.content:
Hello streamers,
Thank you for your wonderful feedback. I have a quick patch for some critical issues. I need some time for bigger issues. A big thank you to everyone who bought and supported the game during early access. I hope that at the end of this adventure we will have a great streaming simulation game.


Korean, Japanese and Simplified Chinese fonts have been edited. 
Fixed font bug in chat messages.
Fixed the issue that when you change the subscriber icon, it does not change in the top panel.
I worked on a bug that crash the game at save time. (I'm still researching for a full solution. During our tests, we found that some virus scanners deleted some files of the game in the background and corrupted the game. Please check this out).
Fixed some sound sources that were not affected by sound settings.
Fixed a bug that prevented some vehicles from getting stuck and resetting.
Refactored a few broken UI texts.
Fixed a bug in the clothing shop that prevented you from interacting with the npc (it was caused by entering the shop on a bike).
Fixed some buggy feedback texts.

v0.12
Fixed a bug causing infinite sleep.
*If you are getting this error or no message from Discat, you can check the our Steam forum thread.

v0.13
Fixed a bug where you couldn't move to day 4.
Fixed a bug that reduced the number of followers to minus.
Fixed a crash when trying to load the game.
Fixed excessive glare of mining device lights.
Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when selling crypto coins.
Fixed a bug that prevented you from interacting with the “Levitron” statue.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890830/Streamer_Life_Simulator_2/
